_what: One place to manage what repo sits on which object in the room.
_how: Under pins, add a line per repo. Simple form: "repo-name": "spot". Fancy form: "repo-name": { "spot": "couch", "name": "...", "blurb": "...", "url": "..." } — name/blurb/url are optional and override what github says. "repo-name": "hide" keeps a repo out of the room entirely. Repos not listed here still work the old way: topic 'room' to appear, topic 'on-couch' (etc.) to pin. This file always wins over topics.
_note: The page reads github's public api, so a private repo only shows up if it's listed here — and then only its name/blurb/url from this file are shown (pick a url visitors can actually open; the repo link 404s for anyone but you).
